controls.seed: Repeatable board wear and fuel shapes; never gameplay RNG.
controls.lid_angle_degrees: Visible opening while the unchanged chest body remains the interaction target.
controls.lid_speed_radians: Cosmetic hinge travel speed following the actual chest panel.
controls.lid_pivot_godot: Rear pin axis in metres relative to the native lattice pose.
controls.plank_gap_m: Visible backed joinery grooves between separate fitted boards.
controls.worked_edge_m: Small physical wear bevel; does not enlarge the native body.
controls.ash_start_fraction: Fraction of the existing burn duration when inert ash becomes visible, before native removal.
controls.ember_recess_m: Depth of real split fuel channels containing combustion light; these are not magical scars.
controls.ember_gain: Local combustion emission only, driven by remaining paid fuel and existing heat.
controls.normal_strength: Restrained inherited grain and worked-metal microrelief.
